CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS malotes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  maloteCode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status ENUM('aberto','enviado','recebido','devolvido') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aberto',
  originUnit VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  destinationUnit VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  createdById INT NOT NULL,
  createdByName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  sentAt DATETIME NULL,
  sentById INT NULL,
  sentByName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  receivedAt DATETIME NULL,
  receivedById INT NULL,
  receivedByName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  receiptNotes TEXT NULL,
  returnReason TEXT NULL,
  createdAt DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maloteItems (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  maloteId INT NOT NULL,
  requestId INT NOT NULL,
  requestCode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  requesterName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  application VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  addedById INT NOT NULL,
  addedByName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  receiptStatus ENUM('pendente','recebido','devolvido') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendente',
  receiptNotes TEXT NULL,
  addedAt DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (maloteId) REFERENCES malotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (requestId) REFERENCES purchaseRequests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
